scope: Candidate Czech national legislation and official guidance, forms, consular instructions, and official court/oversight discovery channels relevant to EU free movement and family members. EU and CJEU source texts are excluded. Czech official guidance also describes similar rights for Icelandic, Liechtenstein, Norwegian, and Swiss citizens; UK Withdrawal Agreement cases are distinct.
retrieval_status: 17 current Czech legal texts, 13 official guidance/index pages, and 13 monitor/discovery pages converted as review candidates; 0 retrieval failures; none accepted
